## NX Labs massive mod providers, rich metadata, dedupe and media proxy (2026-10-01)

**Why.** Owner goal "massive one-click mod install libraries". The catalogue had ~64k rows from Modrinth, Hangar,
Factorio and ficsit natives plus legacy importers; Rust had ~30 rows, Steam-Workshop families lacked
versions/licences/descriptions, there was no cross-provider dedupe, and `/admin/game-mods` loaded every row.

**What shipped (agent "modproviders", branch `feature/mod-providers-massive`).**
- Native providers in `lib/modsync/providers/`: `thunderstore` (valheim, palworld, vrising, corekeeper,
  sonsoftheforest, schedule1, sunkenland; the ~170 MB community dump is cached on disk and stream-parsed via
  `lib/modsync/json-stream.ts`, README + changelog per new/changed package), `spigotmc` (Spiget API only, never
  spigotmc.org), `umod` (ONLY `assets.umod.org` manifest + per-plugin JSON; never the Cloudflare-protected
  umod.org), `github` (curated allow-list `lib/modsync/github-allowlist.ts`, SPDX gate, optional `GITHUB_TOKEN`),
  `steam_workshop` (Steam Web API `QueryFiles`, metadata only, never mirrored), `mod_io`. Registry order and
  `GameMod.source` keys match the legacy rows so existing rows upgrade in place. `Provider` gained `requiresEnv`,
  `keyHelp`, `headers()`; `SyncContext` gained `known()` so providers skip unchanged items (no re-fetch of
  READMEs / versions). A provider whose key is missing is parked with status `needs_key` + message on `/admin/nxlabs`.
- **CurseForge deliberately not built**: its 3rd-party API terms (14 Aug 2024) forbid saving/caching API data and
  building a competing service. See `docs/MODS-SOURCES.md` for every provider's licence/ToS verdict and the
  not-scrape-able list (Nexus, SpigotMC.org, GameBanana/ModDB, paid marketplaces).
- **Depth** (the biggest gap): Modrinth bisects the downloads range into windows that fit Meilisearch's 10k cap and
  walks them all (floor 1000 -> 10 downloads), skipping unchanged projects; Factorio floor 500 -> 20 plus a `/full`
  call per new/changed mod (description, FAQ, changelog, licence mapped to SPDX, links, images, releases with parsed
  dependencies); Hangar versions for every project plus links, authors, normalised dependencies.
- **Schema (additive only)**: `GameMod.websiteUrl issuesUrl wikiUrl discordUrl donationUrl rating ratingCount
  firstPublishedAt clientSide bodyFormat authors duplicateOfId dedupeKey`; `ModVersion.depList clientSide
  serverSideReq`; new table `ModMedia` (icon/screenshot/banner/video, `key` = our cached webp). The existing
  `dependencies` column keeps its provider-native shape; `depList` is the normalised
  `[{kind: required|optional|incompatible|embedded, source, projectId, name?, versionId?}]`. `longDescription`
  holds the raw body (see `bodyFormat`), `bodyHtml` the sanitised render-ready HTML.
- **Media**: icons always cached; screenshots persisted to the NX Labs store ONLY when the licence is
  redistributable. Everything else goes through `GET /api/nxlabs/media/<ModMedia.id>` (stored copy first, else a
  guarded fetch: https, host allowlist `lib/modsync/image-hosts.ts`, DNS-pinned private-range refusal from
  `lib/mods/safe-fetch.ts`, 8 MB cap, resized to WebP, 1-day cache, not written to disk for non-open licences).
  `GameMod.galleryUrls` behaves as before.
- **Cross-provider dedupe** (`lib/modsync/dedupe.ts`, `scripts/modsync.ts dedupe [--family] [--apply]`): same family,
  different sources, same normalised name + author (or same GitHub repo + name). Rows are kept; duplicates get
  `duplicateOfId`; `lib/mods-catalog.ts`, `lib/actions-mod-installs.ts` and `lib/sitemap-mods.ts` filter
  `duplicateOfId: null`. Canonical = redistributable-with-versions, then provider rank, then body, versions,
  downloads (rule documented in `docs/MODS-SOURCES.md`). Run it after ingestion (CLI today; not yet scheduled).
- `/admin/game-mods` is now searched, filtered (game, source, status) and paginated server-side (50 per page).
- Security: API keys are redacted from every error (`redactUrl`), `ModVersion.fileBytes` is clamped to the Int
  range (a 3 GB workshop item crashed the upsert during the proof run), GitHub 403/429 backs the provider off
  instead of hammering.

**Proof run (throwaway DB `nxeon_agt_modproviders`, real APIs, ~55 minutes, stopped early, no images cached, no
mirroring).** Rows not already in prod (prod = 68,438 rows at the time): **+30,535**: modrinth +23,082 (50.8k rows
loaded of ~58k server-relevant, run stopped), valheim thunderstore +2,706, rust uMod +1,024 (29 -> ~1,050; the full
pass is ~1,400), hangar +897, spigotmc +593, factorio +1,127, steam_workshop projectzomboid +500 (capped by
`--max`), vrising +250 (0 -> 250), mod.io +315, palworld/corekeeper thunderstore +30, sdtd uMod +9. Dedupe on the
partial data: 104 groups, 112 duplicates linked. Not proven at scale: GitHub (unauthenticated 60/h exhausted after 2
repos; needs a token), Steam beyond one family, mod.io beyond the weekly legacy run.

**Incident to know about.** Running seven providers at once against the throwaway DB exhausted Postgres'
`max_connections` (100) for ~1 minute because each Prisma client opened its default pool; they were killed at once,
prod answered 200 throughout my checks afterwards. Use `?connection_limit=3` on any ad-hoc ingest URL and run
providers one or two at a time.

**Verification.** `npx tsc --noEmit` clean; `test/modsync-providers.test.ts` (13 tests on recorded real fixtures:
JSON streamer over odd chunk sizes, every parser, dedupe rule, media rules, key redaction, uMod only hits
`assets.umod.org`), existing modsync/installer tests still pass. Media proxy exercised on a dev server: webp out, 24 h
cache, bad id / unknown id / private-IP URL all 404. NOT verified: the admin pages in a browser (auth-gated; only
type-checked and their Prisma queries run on the proof DB), a real mirror run for GitHub assets, live installs of
anything newly catalogued.

**What shipped (agent "modproviders", branch `feature/mod-providers-massive`).**
- Native providers in `lib/modsync/providers/`: `thunderstore` (valheim, palworld, vrising, corekeeper,
  sonsoftheforest, schedule1, sunkenland; the ~170 MB community dump is cached on disk and stream-parsed via
  `lib/modsync/json-stream.ts`, README + changelog per new/changed package), `spigotmc` (Spiget API only, never
  spigotmc.org), `umod` (ONLY `assets.umod.org` manifest + per-plugin JSON; never the Cloudflare-protected
  umod.org), `github` (curated allow-list `lib/modsync/github-allowlist.ts`, SPDX gate, optional `GITHUB_TOKEN`),
  `steam_workshop` (Steam Web API `QueryFiles`, metadata only, never mirrored), `mod_io`. Registry order and
  `GameMod.source` keys match the legacy rows so existing rows upgrade in place. `Provider` gained `requiresEnv`,
  `keyHelp`, `headers()`; `SyncContext` gained `known()` so providers skip unchanged items (no re-fetch of
  READMEs / versions). A provider whose key is missing is parked with status `needs_key` + message on `/admin/nxlabs`.
- **CurseForge deliberately not built**: its 3rd-party API terms (14 Aug 2024) forbid saving/caching API data and
  building a competing service. See `docs/MODS-SOURCES.md` for every provider's licence/ToS verdict and the
  not-scrape-able list (Nexus, SpigotMC.org, GameBanana/ModDB, paid marketplaces).
- **Depth** (the biggest gap): Modrinth bisects the downloads range into windows that fit Meilisearch's 10k cap and
  walks them all (floor 1000 -> 10 downloads), skipping unchanged projects; Factorio floor 500 -> 20 plus a `/full`
  call per new/changed mod (description, FAQ, changelog, licence mapped to SPDX, links, images, releases with parsed
  dependencies); Hangar versions for every project plus links, authors, normalised dependencies.
- **Schema (additive only)**: `GameMod.websiteUrl issuesUrl wikiUrl discordUrl donationUrl rating ratingCount
  firstPublishedAt clientSide bodyFormat authors duplicateOfId dedupeKey`; `ModVersion.depList clientSide
  serverSideReq`; new table `ModMedia` (icon/screenshot/banner/video, `key` = our cached webp). The existing
  `dependencies` column keeps its provider-native shape; `depList` is the normalised
  `[{kind: required|optional|incompatible|embedded, source, projectId, name?, versionId?}]`. `longDescription`
  holds the raw body (see `bodyFormat`), `bodyHtml` the sanitised render-ready HTML.
- **Media**: icons always cached; screenshots persisted to the NX Labs store ONLY when the licence is
  redistributable. Everything else goes through `GET /api/nxlabs/media/<ModMedia.id>` (stored copy first, else a
  guarded fetch: https, host allowlist `lib/modsync/image-hosts.ts`, DNS-pinned private-range refusal from
  `lib/mods/safe-fetch.ts`, 8 MB cap, resized to WebP, 1-day cache, not written to disk for non-open licences).
  `GameMod.galleryUrls` behaves as before.
- **Cross-provider dedupe** (`lib/modsync/dedupe.ts`, `scripts/modsync.ts dedupe [--family] [--apply]`): same family,
  different sources, same normalised name + author (or same GitHub repo + name). Rows are kept; duplicates get
  `duplicateOfId`; `lib/mods-catalog.ts`, `lib/actions-mod-installs.ts` and `lib/sitemap-mods.ts` filter
  `duplicateOfId: null`. Canonical = redistributable-with-versions, then provider rank, then body, versions,
  downloads (rule documented in `docs/MODS-SOURCES.md`). Run it after ingestion (CLI today; not yet scheduled).
- `/admin/game-mods` is now searched, filtered (game, source, status) and paginated server-side (50 per page).
- Security: API keys are redacted from every error (`redactUrl`), `ModVersion.fileBytes` is clamped to the Int
  range (a 3 GB workshop item crashed the upsert during the proof run), GitHub 403/429 backs the provider off
  instead of hammering.

**Proof run (throwaway DB `nxeon_agt_modproviders`, real APIs, ~55 minutes, stopped early, no images cached, no
mirroring).** Rows not already in prod (prod = 68,438 rows at the time): **+30,535**: modrinth +23,082 (50.8k rows
loaded of ~58k server-relevant, run stopped), valheim thunderstore +2,706, rust uMod +1,024 (29 -> ~1,050; the full
pass is ~1,400), hangar +897, spigotmc +593, factorio +1,127, steam_workshop projectzomboid +500 (capped by
`--max`), vrising +250 (0 -> 250), mod.io +315, palworld/corekeeper thunderstore +30, sdtd uMod +9. Dedupe on the
partial data: 104 groups, 112 duplicates linked. Not proven at scale: GitHub (unauthenticated 60/h exhausted after 2
repos; needs a token), Steam beyond one family, mod.io beyond the weekly legacy run.

**Incident to know about.** Running seven providers at once against the throwaway DB exhausted Postgres'
`max_connections` (100) for ~1 minute because each Prisma client opened its default pool; they were killed at once,
prod answered 200 throughout my checks afterwards. Use `?connection_limit=3` on any ad-hoc ingest URL and run
providers one or two at a time.

**Verification.** `npx tsc --noEmit` clean; `test/modsync-providers.test.ts` (13 tests on recorded real fixtures:
JSON streamer over odd chunk sizes, every parser, dedupe rule, media rules, key redaction, uMod only hits
`assets.umod.org`), existing modsync/installer tests still pass. Media proxy exercised on a dev server: webp out, 24 h
cache, bad id / unknown id / private-IP URL all 404. NOT verified: the admin pages in a browser (auth-gated; only
type-checked and their Prisma queries run on the proof DB), a real mirror run for GitHub assets, live installs of
anything newly catalogued.

Done: the work is committed on `feature/mod-providers-massive`, merged with current `main`. Typecheck is clean and 57 tests pass. The throwaway proof run added about 30,535 catalog rows that prod doesn't have.

Two problems during the run, both resolved:
- **DB connections:** my first proof ran seven providers at once and used up Postgres's 100 connections for about a minute. I killed them straight away; prod answered 200 afterwards.
- **uMod:** before your coordinator message my first proof run read `umod.org` search JSON for about 6 pages (~230 rows). I stopped it and deleted those rows. The code now only requests `assets.umod.org`, and a unit test checks that.

- **Branch and worktree:** `/opt/nxeon-wt-modproviders`.
- **Commits:** `7f36ed2a62` (code), `ea315189f3` (docs), `4a54b0c3a5` (merge of `main`; only `docs/DOCUMENTATION.md` conflicted, resolved by keeping both sides).

## Providers added (`lib/modsync/providers/`)
- **thunderstore:** valheim, palworld, vrising, corekeeper, sonsoftheforest, schedule1, sunkenland. The 170 MB community dump is cached on disk and stream-parsed; README and changelog are fetched per new or changed package.
- **spigotmc:** via Spiget only. Spiget's terms (read today) have no restriction on API use; `spigotmc.org` is never requested.
- **umod:** `assets.umod.org` manifest and per-plugin JSON only.
- **github:** a curated allow-list in `lib/modsync/github-allowlist.ts`, with licence taken from GitHub's SPDX field. It works without `GITHUB_TOKEN` but only at 60 requests an hour.
- **steam_workshop:** Web API, metadata only, files never mirrored.
- **mod_io:** metadata only.
- **CurseForge:** not built, per your decision. I wrote it and deleted it before committing.
- **Key-gated providers:** without their key (`STEAM_WEB_API_KEY`, `MODIO_API_KEY`) they park with a `needs_key` message on `/admin/nxlabs` instead of failing. Both keys already exist in `.env`.

I also deepened the providers you already run:
- **Modrinth:** it was capped at 10k hits per project type with a 1000-download floor. It now splits the downloads range into windows under the cap and walks all of them, with the floor at 10, and skips projects that haven't changed.
- **Factorio:** floor lowered from 500 to 20 downloads, plus one extra call per mod for description, licence, changelog and dependencies.
- **Hangar:** versions for every project, plus links, authors and dependencies.

## Schema
All changes are additive:
- **`GameMod`:** new link, rating, client-side, body-format, authors, `duplicateOfId` and `dedupeKey` fields.
- **`ModVersion`:** `depList`, `clientSide`, `serverSideReq`.
- **New table:** `ModMedia`.

## Coverage numbers
Measured on the throwaway DB, real APIs, about 55 minutes, stopped early, no images cached, no mirroring. Rows not already in prod (prod had 68,438 rows at the time):

| Game / provider | Prod before | New rows from proof |
|---|---|---|
| minecraft / modrinth | 32,249 | +23,082 (50.8k loaded, run stopped) |
| valheim / thunderstore | 1,243 | +2,706 |
| factorio | | +1,127 |
| rust / umod | 29 | +1,024 (full pass ~1,400) |
| minecraft / hangar | 1,125 | +897 |
| spigotmc | 7 | +593 |
| steam projectzomboid | 1,000 | +500 (capped by `--max`) |
| vrising / thunderstore | 0 | +250 |
| mod.io | | +315 |
| github | 0 | 2 rows |

GitHub was blocked after 2 repos (unauthenticated limit), so it is not proven at scale. Steam was only run on one family.

## Dedupe and media
- **Dedupe:** on the partial proof data it found 104 groups and linked 112 duplicates. Rule and source ranking are in `docs/MODS-SOURCES.md`. I couldn't tell what "the 11 known groups" were, so I did not target them specifically. Duplicates are hidden from the customer listing and sitemap queries.
- **Media:** icons are always cached. Screenshots are persisted only when the licence is redistributable. Everything else goes through `/api/nxlabs/media/<id>`, which I checked on a dev server: it returned webp with a 24-hour cache, and a bad id, an unknown id and a private-IP URL all returned 404.
- **Admin:** `/admin/game-mods` is now searched, filtered and paginated server-side. I ran its queries against the proof DB (522 ms) but did not render it in a browser (login-gated).

## Needs from you
- **`GITHUB_TOKEN`:** optional but recommended; without it the GitHub provider takes about 100 minutes per pass.
- **mod.io:** someone to read its API terms (JS-rendered, couldn't be read) before it runs at volume.
- **Modrinth:** written OK from `support@modrinth.com` for the full crawl and mirror.
- **Dedupe:** run `scripts/modsync.ts dedupe --apply` after the first big prod ingest. It isn't scheduled yet.
- **Deploy:** needs a `prisma db push` (additive).
- **Cleanup:** drop the throwaway DB with `sudo -u postgres dropdb nxeon_agt_modproviders`.

## Files edited outside the modsync area
- **`lib/mods-catalog.ts`, `lib/actions-mod-installs.ts`, `lib/sitemap-mods.ts`:** one-line `duplicateOfId: null` filters; these may conflict with K1 or K5.
- **`prisma/schema.prisma`:** additive columns on the Mod models.

Notes are in `/root/agent-notes/modproviders.md`, and the proof logs are in `/root/modproviders-proof`.

Branch feature/mod-providers-massive, worktree /opt/nxeon-wt-modproviders. Commits: 7f36ed2a62 (code), ea315189f3 (docs), 4a54b0c3a5 (merge of main; only docs/DOCUMENTATION.md conflicted, kept both sides). tsc clean, 57 tests pass (13 new in test/modsync-providers.test.ts on recorded real fixtures).

INCIDENTS
1. Seven concurrent ingest processes exhausted Postgres max_connections (100) for ~1 min (Prisma default pool each). Killed immediately; prod answered 200 afterwards. Use ?connection_limit=3 on ad-hoc ingest URLs.
2. Before the coordinator message, my first proof run used umod.org/plugins/search.json for ~6 pages (~230 rows). Stopped and rows deleted. Code now only requests assets.umod.org (unit-tested).

PROVIDERS ADDED (lib/modsync/providers)
- thunderstore: valheim, palworld, vrising, corekeeper, sonsoftheforest, schedule1, sunkenland. Streamed 170 MB dump, README+changelog per package. Metadata-only (no licence, no published ToS).
- spigotmc: via Spiget only (ToS read, no restriction); spigotmc.org never touched. Metadata-only.
- umod: assets.umod.org manifest + per-plugin JSON only (licence, sha1, requires). Metadata-only.
- github: curated allow-list (lib/modsync/github-allowlist.ts), SPDX gate, optional GITHUB_TOKEN (1 req/min without). Mirror-if-licensed.
- steam_workshop: Web API, metadata only, never mirrored. Needs STEAM_WEB_API_KEY.
- mod_io: metadata only. Needs MODIO_API_KEY.
- CurseForge NOT built (API terms forbid caching); written then deleted.
- Key-gated providers park with a needs_key admin message instead of failing. Both keys already exist in .env.
- Depth upgrades: Modrinth splits downloads ranges under the 10k search cap (floor 1000 -> 10) and skips unchanged projects; Factorio floor 500 -> 20 plus /full enrichment; Hangar versions for all projects plus links and deps.

SCHEMA (additive only)
- GameMod: websiteUrl, issuesUrl, wikiUrl, discordUrl, donationUrl, rating, ratingCount, firstPublishedAt, clientSide, bodyFormat, authors, duplicateOfId, dedupeKey.
- ModVersion: depList, clientSide, serverSideReq.
- New table ModMedia.

OTHER CHANGES
- Dedupe: lib/modsync/dedupe.ts and CLI "scripts/modsync.ts dedupe [--apply]". Rule and source ranking are in docs/MODS-SOURCES.md. Customer listings and sitemap hide duplicates. On partial proof data: 104 groups, 112 duplicates linked. I could not identify "the 11 known groups", so they were not targeted specifically.
- Media: icons always cached; screenshots persisted only when the licence is redistributable. Otherwise served via /api/nxlabs/media/<id> (host allowlist, DNS-pinned SSRF guard). Verified on a dev server: webp out, 24h cache, bad id / unknown id / private-IP URL all 404.
- /admin/game-mods is now searched, filtered and paginated server-side; its queries run on the proof DB (522 ms). Not rendered in a browser (auth-gated).
- Other fixes: API keys redacted from errors; fileBytes clamped to Int range (a 3 GB workshop item crashed an upsert); GitHub 403/429 backs the provider off; Factorio titles that are literally "." fall back to the mod name.

COVERAGE (proof run on throwaway DB, real APIs, ~55 min, stopped early, no images, no mirroring)
Rows not already in prod (prod had 68,438): +30,535 total.
- modrinth +23,082 (50.8k loaded vs 32,249 before)
- valheim thunderstore +2,706
- factorio +1,127
- rust umod +1,024 (29 before; full pass ~1,400)
- hangar +897
- spigotmc +593
- steam projectzomboid +500 (capped by --max)
- vrising thunderstore +250 (0 before)
- mod.io +315
- palworld/corekeeper thunderstore +30
- sdtd umod +9
- github 2 rows only
Not proven at scale: GitHub (unauthenticated 60/h exhausted), Steam beyond one family, mod.io beyond the weekly legacy run. Not verified: admin pages in a browser, GitHub mirroring, live installs of newly catalogued mods.

NEEDS OWNER
- GITHUB_TOKEN (optional, recommended).
- A human to read mod.io API terms (JS-rendered, unreadable by me).
- Written OK from support@modrinth.com for the full crawl and mirror.
- Run scripts/modsync.ts dedupe --apply after the first big prod ingest (not scheduled).
- prisma db push at deploy (additive).
- Drop throwaway DB: sudo -u postgres dropdb nxeon_agt_modproviders.

FILES EDITED OUTSIDE MODSYNC AREA (possible conflicts with K1/K5)
- lib/mods-catalog.ts, lib/actions-mod-installs.ts, lib/sitemap-mods.ts (one-line duplicateOfId: null filters)
- prisma/schema.prisma (additive Mod model columns)

Notes: /root/agent-notes/modproviders.md; proof logs and artefacts in /root/modproviders-proof.
